config.boundary: Point Newtonian source plus constant external Newtonian field. Physical background mapped from the exact h=0 scalar limit. Zero anomalous central integration mass for the monopole.
config.claim_ceiling: Conditional historical summary screen only. No full Solar System pass, observed galaxy/cluster/lensing success, dynamical stability or new fundamental law established.
config.classification: No classification when numerical gates fail. Near-edge numerical spread is descriptive, not a rigorous error bound. Both declared Galactic backgrounds and all six monopole orbits required for the combined summary screen.
config.controls: High-precision kernel derivatives; full Cartesian versus analytic point flux; radial variation; periodic action variation and momentum; ell=0 independent scalar quadrupole; independent infinite-domain action/flux quadrupole integrals.
config.epsilon_reason: The new action uses the excess itself, so its epsilon-dependent constant can affect the force. Smaller regulator frozen before physical predictions; convergence checked explicitly.
config.length_selection: Fixed decade grid from 206 AU to 10 pc plus exact scalar control. Covers compact-system screening while remaining below disk thickness scales; no values chosen from new local predictions.
config.observations_access: Previously exposed published summaries only. No new raw or reserved measurements.
config.registration: Frozen before physical length-dependent local predictions. Earlier scalar/multifield local summaries and development galaxy/cluster residuals are exposed; no confirmation claim.
